What Pet Garden does

Grooming

Haircuts and baths for dogs. Customers write that the groomers take time to understand each dog, handle them gently and pay attention to detail.

Pet hotel

Boarding while you travel. One customer boarded a dog for 25 days and picked him up freshly bathed and groomed.

Pick-up and delivery

A delivery service for pets: one customer uses it before work and picks the dog up at lunchtime.

Pet shop

Food, supplies, beds and a wall of toys for dogs and cats, as the shop’s own photos show.

A salon in Germasogeia

Pet Garden is on Akarnanias in Germasogeia, a grooming salon, pet hotel and shop under one long awning, with the Scottish terrier of the logo above the door. The Google rating is 4.8 across 172 reviews, and the Facebook page has 4.900 followers. There is no website of its own: the website field in the Google listing points only to Facebook.
